Exploitability Assessment: High. The vulnerabilities are directly related to SQL injection, which is a well-known and easily exploitable issue.
Business Impact: High. SQL injection can lead to data theft, manipulation, or complete loss of sensitive information, severely impacting operations and reputation.
Remediation Priority: Fix the SQL injection vulnerabilities first as they pose the highest risk.
Remediation Order: Replace manually constructed SQL strings with prepared statements in /SqlInjectionAdvanced/register method.
Ensure all user inputs are properly sanitized and validated before use in SQL queries across the application.
Review and update the login method to ensure it does not expose any vulnerabilities.
